svg.title: Paper Fig. 2 adaptation: ten seed absolute hot RMSE for four separately trained arms
svg.desc: Four region year panels with jittered dots per seed for four CNN arms and horizontal markers for persistence and blend baselines. RMSE in K; lower is better. Data from archived report replay.
svg.text: Paper Fig. 2 · 10 paired seeds per case · ERA5 observed-hot (verifying T ≥305 K) RMSE; lower is better
P = 24-h persistence reference; B = persistence–climatology blend; S = source-mean input; H = historical climatology input.
Dots: individually fitted seeds; short bars: mean CNN RMSE or single reference RMSE. Full verification evidence: Actions 42124190191.
